systems.system: Centralised Interior Management and Administration System (CMAS)

NGA.note: CMAS integrates data among agencies under the Interior ministry only, a single ministry's integration, so it is not recorded.
Nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the national ID system.
The article concerns immigration records, not other systems checking people against the national ID.
The data centre of over eight petabytes is not said to be for hire or who owns it.
